title: Data Governance for Generative and Agentic AI : Technology, Law, Economics, and Security
abstract: arXiv:2610.33605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This book develops a unified governance framework for systems that retrieve, generate, infer, remember and act on information from large language models and retrieval augmented pipelines to autonomous multi agent systems. Eleven chapters and eight appendices integrate three disciplinary lenses-technology, law and economics-across the full lifecycle: data quality, lineage and provenance; global data protection law and intellectual property; the economics of data governance; digital trust, cybersecurity and zero-trust architecture; ethics and responsible AI; governing generative AI pipelines; governing agentic AI and multi-agent systems; data governance in elections and the public sphere; AI regulation across six jurisdictions; and the design of a governance control plane for 2030. Each chapter is anchored in Indian law and institutions while maintaining a comparative, cross jurisdictional perspective.

translated_title: 生成式与智能体AI的数据治理：技术、法律、经济学与安全
translated_abstract: 本书为从大语言模型和检索增强管道到自主多智能体系统等能够检索、生成、推理、记忆并基于信息采取行动的系统，构建了一个统一的治理框架。全书共十一章和八个附录，从技术、法律和经济学三个学科视角贯穿全生命周期，内容涵盖：数据质量、血缘与溯源；全球数据保护法与知识产权；数据治理的经济学；数字信任、网络安全与零信任架构；伦理与负责任AI；生成式AI管道的治理；智能体AI与多智能体系统的治理；选举与公共领域中的数据治理；六个司法管辖区的AI监管；以及面向2030年的治理控制平面设计。每一章都以印度法律和制度为锚点，同时保持比较性与跨司法管辖区的视角。
tldr: 本书提出一个统一的数据治理框架，融合技术、法律与经济学三重视角，覆盖从大语言模型到自主多智能体系统在内的AI系统全生命周期治理，并以印度法律为基础提供跨司法管辖区的比较视角。
en_tdlr: This book develops a unified data governance framework that integrates technological, legal, and economic perspectives across the full lifecycle of AI systems, from LLMs to autonomous multi-agent systems, anchored in Indian law while maintaining a comparative cross-jurisdictional perspective.
